changelog:
exam-mnemonic-song v0.1.1

- Initial release of the Exam Mnemonic Song Studio.
- Turn a single exam knowledge point into a mnemonic song; organize the rest into a labeled set.
- Delivers a free, fully-labeled lyric sheet for review before music generation.
- Integrates pay-per-song workflow with live credit and billing checks.
- Uses only bundled command-line client for Beatra operations; no external connectors or REST.
- Enables automatic in-place skill updates with robust recovery.
summary: Turn one exam knowledge point into a mnemonic song you can replay, then turn the rest of the syllabus into a set. This exam mnemonic song studio writes a knowledge-point song and exam memory song from the facts you already have. Use it for bar-exam mnemonics, teacher-certification songs, accounting-exam memory songs, and other exam mnemonic playlists.
